propertyQuotes.evidenceText: Google Hotels identified Road Lodge Cape Town International Airport at Cape Town International Airport, Airport Approach Rd, Matroosfontein, Cape Town, 7490, South Africa as a 1-star hotel. The result displayed $55 nightly and $63 total for 1 night with taxes + fees, with the occupancy control set to 2 Adults. The retained value is the directly displayed one-night $63 total including taxes and fees; no arithmetic was performed.
